Hari Singh Since Deceased Son Of Chidda ... vs State Of
Haryana And Others on 24 December, 2025

Author: Anupinder Singh Grewal
Bench: Anupinder Singh Grewal

In The High Court Of Punjab And Haryana At Chandigarh
119 Cwp-39092-2025 (O&M)
Date of decision : 24.12.2025
Hari Singh through his LRs and others ..Petitioners
Versus
State of Haryana and others .. Respondents
Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anupinder Singh Grewal
Hon''Ble Mr. Justice Deepak Manchanda
Present: Mr. Gaurav Arora, Advocate for the petitioners.

entities.text: High Court Of Punjab And Haryana At Chandigarh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. Anant Kataria, Dag Haryana.

aR ae 2s 3
Anupinder Singh Grewal, J. (Oral)

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are residing in houses built on small residential plots carved out of Khasra Nos.64/1 and 62/4/1 situated in village Shahupura, Tehsil Ballabhgarh, District Faridabad.
They had constructed the houses much prior to the acquisition of the land in 1995 and they have been in possession since three decades.
Neither any compensation was paid to them nor possession been secured by the respondents.
Now, suddenly, the respondents by the impugned order dated 07.11.2025 have directed their eviction.
The order is also manifestly non-speaking and cryptic.

He has referred to the Government Policy issued on 24.01.2011 which provides for the release of the self-inhabited residential structures which existed prior to the issuance of the notification under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 and submits that the petitioners would be squarely covered under the policy.
He further submits that the official respondents have released the land of similarly situated owner-one M/s JK CWP-39092-2025 (O&M) 2 petitioners.

2. Issue notice to the respondents.
3.
Mr. Anant Kataria, DAG Haryana accepts notice on behalf of the respondent-State and submits that the petitioners have an alternative remedy of preferring an appeal under Section 20 of the HSVP Act.

sentences.text: 4. At this stage, learned counsel for the petitioners submits that he shall be preferring an appeal but the petitioners may be protected till the appeal is decided.
5. The petitioners are stated to have been residing in the residential houses built on land notified for acquisition in 1995, for about three decades.
It would be in the interest of justice, if they are protected till the appeal is decided.
We, therefore, deem it appropriate to dispose of this petition with liberty to the petitioners to prefer an appeal against the impugned order within a period of 10 days.
In the event of the appeal being preferred, the Appellate Authority would consider and decide the same in accordance with law within a period of three months thereafter.
Till a decision is taken in the appeal, the parties shall maintain status quo.
6. All pending miscellaneous application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of.

(ANUPINDER SINGH GREWAL) JUDGE (DEEPAK MANCHANDA) 24.12.2025 JUDGE sapna Whether speaking/reasoned : Yes/No Whether reportable : Yes/No Hari Singh Since Deceased Son Of Chidda ... vs State Of Haryana And Others on 24 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14427940/
